quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (half-year report): net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 133,202,881.71, up 4.42%; operating cost rose 26.94% to RMB 389,930,933.07; financial expenses rose by RMB 1,875 ten-thousand on FX losses and convertible-bond interest; operating cash flow RMB 58,114,249.30 (+35.61%). The wholly owned subsidiary in Lianyungang, which makes spherical products and liquid fillers, had H1 revenue RMB 226,113,345.11 and net profit RMB 42,983,436.99.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity projects (half-year report): the 'ultra-pure spherical powder for high-performance high-speed substrates' project (budget RMB 423,239,800.00) was 24.93% complete at end-June 2026, with a planned 36-month construction period and phase 1 built and in production; the 'high-thermal-conductivity high-purity spherical powder' project has a planned 18-month construction period.A new 'high-performance spherical silica for advanced packaging' project (budget RMB 75,000,000.00) was 24.86% complete, and the advanced-packaging high-performance spherical powder project (budget RMB 50,000,000.00) reached 100.00% progress.
quarterly_data.figure: high-speed substrate powder project 24.93% complete; new advanced-packaging spherical silica project budget RMB 75,000,000.00

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (half-year report): H1 2026 R&D spend RMB 32,598,038.45, up 7.8%, 5.18% of revenue; 112 R&D staff. New projects: Top cut 3um spherical alumina for advanced packaging (UF, L-MUF, EMC, DAF; laboratory stage); Low-alpha spherical alumina for 2.5D/3D chip packaging (HBM, GMC, LMC, POP; laboratory stage); nano spherical silica for advanced-packaging processes (laboratory stage); negative-thermal-expansion powder for low-CTE IC substrates, aimed at FC-BGA, power-device and high-frequency high-speed packaging (laboratory stage); large-particle liquid-phase spherical silica with Df<0.0002 for high-frequency high-speed substrates (engineering stage); single-crystal aluminium nitride for thermal interface materials (engineering stage). The Df<=0.0003 ultra-pure spherical silica for M9 LVL-and-above substrates is at the industrialization stage, Top cut 3um spherical silica for 2.5D packaging moved to the engineering stage, and submicron spherical alumina for UF and the aluminium nitride and boron nitride thermal fillers were industrialized and closed.
